quick.productName: TRAILHEAD CRUNCH Barra de Miel y Cacahuate

analysis.summary: This is a honey and peanut snack bar. It lists peanuts as an ingredient, which matters most for your peanut allergy. It also has honey and a tree nut cross-contact warning.

personalFlags.title: Contains peanut
personalFlags.explanation: Peanuts are a main ingredient and are also listed in the allergen statement. This bar is not safe for a peanut allergy.

personalFlags.title: May contain tree nuts
personalFlags.explanation: The label says it may contain tree nuts and is made in a plant that also processes them. This is a cross-contact risk.
personalFlags.evidence: Puede contener nueces, leche, trigo y ajonjolí.

personalFlags.title: Contains honey
personalFlags.explanation: Honey is made by bees, so it conflicts with a vegan diet.

personalFlags.title: May contain milk
personalFlags.explanation: Milk is listed as a possible cross-contact allergen. Check with the maker if this matters for your vegan diet.
personalFlags.evidence: Puede contener nueces, leche, trigo y ajonjolí.

personalFlags.title: Natural flavor source unclear
personalFlags.explanation: Natural flavor can come from animal sources. Check with the maker if you want to be sure it is vegan.

labelWarnings.text: Made in a plant that also processes nuts, milk, wheat and sesame.
labelWarnings.evidence: Elaborado en una planta que también procesa estos alérgenos.

keyFacts.label: Storage
keyFacts.value: Keep in a cool, dry place

analysis.disclaimer: This explains the label and is not medical advice. Ask a pharmacist or doctor if you are unsure about anything.
